channel.title: Anokhi Ada — Product Catalog
channel.description: Indian clothing boutique in Atlanta — hand-selected sarees, bridal lehengas, and trousseau pieces.

item.title: Red Floral Organza Kurta Set
item.description: Deep red pintucked kurta and matching pants, layered under a sheer organza jacket hand-embroidered with vivid multicolor florals and beaded detailing.

item.title: Orange Kora Embroidered Sharara Set
item.description: Rust-orange kora kurta finished with intricate silver hand embroidery at the neckline and hem, paired with a flowing georgette sharara and a matching embroidered dupatta accented with blue and red jewel detailing.

item.title: Light Blue Chanderi Embroidered Kurta Set
item.description: Light blue chanderi kurta in a subtle checkered weave, hand-embroidered with ivory dora-work florals at the collar, placket, and cuffs, finished with fabric rosette buttons and paired with matching straight pants.

item.title: Color-Blocked Silk Anarkali Set
item.description: Sleeveless anarkali in vertical color-blocked panels of purple, red, orange, and magenta silk, finished with a hand-beaded and sequined neckline, paired with wide-leg pants and a magenta dupatta in gold booti print with a paisley border.

item.title: Purple Zardozi Embroidered Kurta Set
item.description: Purple silk kurta densely embroidered with gold zardozi florals and a beaded scalloped neckline, paired with wide-leg georgette palazzo pants and a sheer draped cape in matching purple.

item.title: Mustard Floral Saree
item.description: Golden mustard silk with a delicate golden floral vine running throughout, finished with a wide zari border, paired with a deep maroon striped blouse.

item.title: Fuchsia Banarasi
item.description: Vivid fuchsia silk patterned with a diagonal floral lattice, framed by a wide gold-and-pink brocade border, paired with an ivory silk blouse embroidered to match.

item.title: Rust Circle-Motif Saree
item.description: Warm rust silk woven with a bold silver ring motif and a soft gold border, paired with a matching rust blouse carrying the same circle pattern.

item.title: Light Blue Banarasi Minakari Saree
item.description: Light blue Banarasi silk saree woven with intricate gold zari paisleys and delicate minakari detailing throughout, finished with a fringed border and paired with a matching gold-trimmed silk blouse.

item.title: Emerald Sequin Halter Saree
item.description: Deep emerald chiffon saree finished with a hand-sequined gold border and scattered bird-and-leaf motifs in gold thread, paired with a fully beaded gold halter blouse.

item.title: Ivory Ready-to-Wear Saree
item.description: Ivory ombré-dyed ready saree with sequins blouse.

item.title: Purple Lace Ready-to-Wear Saree
item.description: Very light weight purple ready saree with net blouse with 3D work.

item.title: Dusty Rose Floral Chaniya Choli
item.description: Navy striped wrap blouse paired with a dusty rose floral-print flared skirt and a matching printed dupatta framed in navy trim.

item.title: Mustard Block-Print Chaniya Choli
item.description: Halter-neck blouse and flared skirt in a hand block-printed floral pattern, paired with an ivory sequined dupatta finished in gold and tasseled edges.

item.title: Purple Mirror Work Printed Chaniya Choli
item.description: Purple silk blouse embellished with mirror work, beading, and shell tassels at the sleeves, paired with a printed pure maal cotton lehenga in a floral yellow-green and mauve pattern, finished with a matching mirror-worked purple dupatta.

item.title: Vintage Hand-Embroidered Chaniya Choli
item.description: Mustard silk blouse and a red cotton skirt both finished with vintage hand embroidery in a bold multicolor geometric pattern, paired with a teal mirror-work dupatta trimmed in mustard.

item.title: Nude Embroidered Net Lehenga Set
item.description: Nude net lehenga densely hand-embroidered with multicolor floral and leaf motifs in beads and sequins, paired with a lightly embroidered nude blouse and a matching georgette dupatta.

item.title: Grey Tissue Crop Top & Red Pleated Skirt
item.description: Grey tissue crop top hand-embroidered with multicolor floral thread work and finished with a beaded scalloped hem, cut sleeveless with a high round neck, paired with a full pleated skirt in textured red with a drawstring waist and side pockets.

item.title: Blush Georgette Lehenga & Halter Blouse
item.description: Nude-blush georgette lehenga hand-embroidered all over with multicolor floral thread work, sequins, and mirror accents in soft pink, yellow, and mint, paired with a mint halter blouse finished with a coral and mirror-work trimmed neckline and a matching mint georgette dupatta scattered with mirror butis.

item.title: Lavender Draped Lehenga & Embroidered Blouse
item.description: Soft lavender crushed georgette lehenga with the dupatta pre-pleated and attached at the waist, so the drape falls into place without pinning, finished with an embroidered waistband and a wide silver border at the hem. Paired with a sleeveless blouse hand-embroidered in silver sequins and beadwork in a scalloped medallion pattern, with a matching scalloped band across the open back.

item.title: Mustard Crushed Lehenga & Embroidered Blouse
item.description: Mustard yellow crushed georgette lehenga shot through with fine gold stripes and finished with a wide gota border at the hem, paired with a raw silk blouse hand-embroidered all over in gold zardozi florals with a zip back, and a tissue dupatta trimmed in gold fringe and pearl beading.

item.title: Purple Draped Lehenga & Embroidered Blouse
item.description: Deep purple crushed silk lehenga worked in vertical rows of silver sequin and pearl scallops, with the dupatta pre-pleated and attached at the waist so the drape falls into place without pinning. Paired with a heavily hand-embroidered blouse in silver zardozi, mirror, and pearl work, finished with a scalloped deep V back.

item.title: Chartreuse Draped Lehenga & Sequined Blouse
item.description: Chartreuse silk lehenga scattered with silver appliqué florals and finished with a heavily beaded waistband, the net dupatta pre-draped and attached at the waist so it falls into place without pinning. Paired with a blouse hand-embroidered all over in silver sequins, mirrors, and beading, finished with a low V back and beaded straps.

item.title: Grey Tissue Draped Lehenga & Embroidered Blouse
item.description: Silver-grey tissue lehenga with a soft metallic sheen, worn with a deep purple dupatta pre-draped and attached at the waist so it falls into place without pinning, its edge finished in silver floral embroidery and a scalloped border. Paired with a deep purple blouse hand-embroidered in silver zardozi and sage-green florals, with a V neckline and an open back fastened with tasselled ties, over a matching embroidered waistband at the skirt.

item.title: Blue Printed Lehenga & One-Shoulder Blouse
item.description: Blue printed lehenga with embellishments and a one-shoulder blouse.

item.title: Taupe Lehenga & Embroidered Vest
item.description: Taupe lehenga with attached dupatta and a vest with a blouse inside.

item.title: Green Tissue Lehenga & Sequin Blouse
item.description: Green tissue with attached dupatta and hand-embroidered sequins blouse.

item.title: Blush Pink Asymmetric Top & Skirt
item.description: Blush pink top hand-embroidered in silver sequins and beadwork in a fine geometric chevron pattern, cut with a high round neckline and an asymmetric peplum that dips low on one side, finished with sequinned straps that cross at the open back. Paired with a floor-length crushed georgette skirt in matching blush, lightly sequinned throughout.

item.title: Lavender Sequin Palazzo Set
item.description: Soft lavender georgette hand-embroidered throughout with gold sequins, beadwork, and fine thread in a trailing floral vine, cut as a sleeveless crop top with deep V necklines front and back, paired with high-waisted wide-leg palazzo pants.

item.title: Yellow Printed Wide-Leg Pants & Embroidered Crop Top
item.description: Deep red crop top hand-embroidered front and back with trailing floral vines in gold zardozi, sequins, and soft green thread work, finished with a scooped neckline and an exposed metal zip, paired with wide-leg pants printed in sunflower yellow with bold rose clusters and an ombré-dyed georgette dupatta shading from bottle green to fuchsia, scattered with gold butis.

item.title: Blush Pink Beaded Sharara Set
item.description: Blush pink tiered georgette sharara paired with a silver hand-beaded floral blouse, layered under a floor-length georgette cape finished with beaded trim and scattered embellishment.

item.title: Black Mirror Work Cape Set
item.description: Floor-length black georgette cape densely embellished with silver mirror work in a scalloped floral pattern, paired with a matching mirror-work blouse and a black satin skirt with a draped, knotted front.

item.title: Brown Sequin Embroidered Sharara Set
item.description: Deep brown blouse densely embroidered with silver and gold sequins, paired with a tiered brown georgette sharara and a matching georgette cape hand-embroidered with metallic floral vines and sequin trim.

item.title: Maroon Zardozi Halter Top & Wide-Leg Pants
item.description: A beautiful hand-embroidered zardozi and sequins halter blouse with high-waisted wide-leg pants.

item.title: Black & Gold Antique-Work Evening Gown
item.description: Floor-length black gown in finely pleated georgette, the bodice worked in antique gold zardozi, beading, and sequins in a scalloped medallion pattern that repeats along the waist and back edges. Cut with a deep V neckline, cut-outs at the waist, and an open back framed in the same scalloped trim.
